articles.text:
Crowd control measures in place, vehicles stopped at city entry points

A DAY after 30 people died and 60 were injured ina pre-dawn stampede near the Sangam in Prayagraj, the administration issued a string of directives Thursdayand cancelled all WIP passes and declared the entire MahaKumbharea as a no-vehicle zone. Routes for devotees have been made one-way to avoid overlapping given the huge nish of people heading to the ghats and returning after a dip. Entry of vehicles from alladsoining districts has been hanned

and these will be stopped outside Prayagraj city. Instructions have also goneout to completely ban entry of four-wheelers in-

Kumbh stampede, in Prayagr:

side the city until February 4. Anofficer on security duty said, "Ithas been communicated that WIP passes have been revoked, meaning special passes wil no longer allow vehicleentry. One-wayroutes have been introduced tofacilitate smooth movement of people. Additionally, vehicleentry has been restricted at the district borders, A strict ban on vehicleentryinto the city will remain in place until February 4."
